title: Removing an element and its negation costs at most two
statement:
Let $S$ be a finite subset of an additive group $V$, and let $u \in S$. Then
\[
\abs{S} \le \abs{\{\, v \in S : v \neq u \text{ and } v \neq -u \,\}} + 2.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S is a finite subset of V
u is an element of S
replaced:
For a finite subset $S$ of an additive group and $u \in S$,
$\abs{S} \le \abs{\{\, v \in S : v \neq u \text{ and } v \neq -u \,\}} + 2$.
